newsitem.title: CANADA: Stelco blast furnace shut for 12 days.
newsitem.headline: Stelco blast furnace shut for 12 days.

text.p: Stelco Inc said on Thursday operations at its Hilton Works blast furnace will shut down the furnace for 12 days.
Operations were curtailed on Wednesday at one of Hilton Works' two blast furnaces as a result of operating difficulties, the company said.

"Given our on-going steel production and the use of existing semi-finished steel inventories, downstream production units and shipments to customers will not be adversely affected," Paul Paciocco, vice-president and general manager at Hilton Works said in a statement.
The financial impact of this business disruption is partially offset by insurance coverage, the company said.
